title: Fix waveform click-to-seek: mouse not in scope in seekHere()
description: PlaybackWaveform MouseArea handlers call a named function seekHere() that references the handler-injected 'mouse' parameter — outside the handler scope it is a ReferenceError, so clicks never emit seekRequested. Smoke test invoked the signal directly (QMetaObject) and missed the real mouse path. Fix: pass mouse.x via arrow-function handler params into a parameterized helper; add drag scrubbing; cover with a real QTest.mouseClick in the ab_waveform scenario.
close_reason: Fixed: PlaybackWaveform MouseArea handlers called a named seekHere() that referenced the handler-scoped 'mouse' parameter — a ReferenceError on every click, so seek never fired (reproduced in an isolated probe: 'ReferenceError: mouse is not defined'). title: Worker shutdown can close engine under a live inference thread (crash-on-quit)
description: InferenceWorker.stop() waits only 5s and the stream loop checks _cancel but never _stop, so a quit during a long render leaves the QThread running. AppController.shutdown() then drops the worker ref (QThread destroyed while running) and calls engine.close() while the thread may still be inside infer/infer_stream — native crash risk (ONNX session freed in use). Fix: stop() sets _cancel too; stream loop and _check_cancelled honor _stop; AppController.shutdown() skips engine.close() when the worker thread is still alive.

title: Cancel-then-resubmit race: stale done from the cancelled job clobbers the new job state
description: InferenceWorker.submit() clears the cancel flag at enqueue time on the caller thread.
